Get on Google Play Explore Features ↓

What's Inside

Built for the Night

🕐

Live Clock Display

Real-time ticking clock with large, glowing digits. Supports both 12-hour and 24-hour formats. Rotate to landscape for a stunning fullscreen view.

🎨

4 Cosmic Themes

Choose from Watery Lagoon, Cyber Neon Pulse, Warm Ember, and Midnight Cosmic — each with unique animated backgrounds and color palettes.

🌙

Sleep Ambient Timer

Set a sleep timer from 1 to 90 minutes. Let ambient sound fade out gently as you drift off without touching your phone.

🎵

Synthesizer Soundscapes

Five built-in ambient sounds: Silence, Soothing Waves, Cyber Neon Rain, Golden Melodies, and Deep Cosmos Drone.

✨

Animated Backgrounds

Each theme brings a living, breathing background — twinkling stars with shooting comets, sine wave oceans, neon grids, and glowing ember particles.

⚡

Lightweight & Fast

Designed to be battery-friendly as a bedside clock. Smooth 60fps animations with no compromise on performance.
